newsitem.title: UK: John Menzies make management changes at ELC.
newsitem.headline: John Menzies make management changes at ELC.

text.p: British retailer John Menzies Plc said on Tuesday it was making changes to the management at its Early Learning Centre (ELC) division.

Chief executive Ian Duncan and managing director Andrew Crankshaw are leaving, while Dermot Jenkinson, a director of John Menzies and the chairman of ELC, will manage the business until a successor is appointed, the group said in a statement.
John Menzies said trading at ELC continued to be affected by "competition and changes to shopping habits".
However, after a thorough review, including looking at approaches from companies interested in buying ELC, it had decided to continue the business.
In January, John Menzies said ELC had not reacted fast enough to growing competition from Woolworths, Argos, Boots and Toys R Us.
